example_pantheon.story.first_star.title: The First Star's Unfinished Map
example_pantheon.story.first_star.call.d: Bring care, not a claim to certainty.
example_pantheon.story.first_star.call.p: Vesper unfolds a chart whose last road ends before the village. The cartographer left that stretch blank rather than invent a safe crossing. People remember the omission as either cowardice or mercy.
